essence: True awakening discloses things as they are: its rays reveal the true essence of world-objects.
In You, being-full, I the self enter bliss — ingress, not feeling.
Awakening discloses; entry is bliss; pūrṇa (full/complete) is the Lord's nature.

sections.SUMMARY: True awakening discloses things as they are; bliss is entry into the Lord's fullness — ingress, not feeling.

rasa.sthayibhava: ānanda (bliss) as entry into the Lord's fullness
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of entry (praveśa); the vyabhicāri is bliss (ānanda) of awakening. The rasa is bliss as ingress, not as feeling — the devotee enters what the Lord already is.
